title: Unsolved Cipher Benchmark Record
description: Schema for a single record in the UNSOLVED area of the cipher benchmark. Relaxed from the main schema: solution_reference and plaintext_file are optional (and usually absent), status is constrained to unsolved/disputed variants, and a new partial_solution_evidence field captures what signal exists in lieu of ground truth.

source_record_id.description: Identifier in the original source system

task_tracks.description: image2hypothesis is unique to the unsolved area: open-ended analysis with no automated scoring, evaluated against a human rubric or by community review.

rights_class.description: Same semantics as the main schema.

status.description: unsolved = no widely accepted solution. disputed = one or more claimed solutions exist without consensus. partial_solution = some sections solved, others not. Aligned with the main schema's status enum so downstream tooling can share a single vocabulary.

partial_solution_evidence.description: What signal exists short of ground truth. 'interlineation_visible' = contemporary plaintext written in/near the cipher text on the document itself. 'adjacent_corpus_solved' = closely related records from the same correspondent/volume/key-family have been solved.

cipher_type.description: Cipher family classification if hypothesized; leave empty or ['unknown'] otherwise.

plaintext_language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the (hypothesized) plaintext language. In the unsolved area this is speculative by definition — use empty string for truly unknown cases (e.g. Voynich). Named the same as in the main schema for vocabulary consistency.

synthetic.description: True for records generated programmatically rather than drawn from a historical manuscript. Rare in the unsolved area (synthetic records are by construction solvable) but included for schema parity with the main schema.

image_provenance.description: Structured record of where/how the image was fetched. Parity with the main schema's field of the same name.

length_chars.description: Approximate cipher-character count, for length-based filtering.

notable_attempts.description: Citations for notable but inconclusive or disputed decipherment attempts.
